docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Wilson’s translations of Sanskrit plays, with his essay on the Hindu theatre and its history, the first English account of the classical Indian drama (Calcutta, 1827). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Select specimens of the theatre of the Hindus · Wilson, H. H. (Horace Hayman), 1786-1860 · 1827, 322 scanned pages. Published 1827; Horace Hayman Wilson died 1860; the plays are ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
